thread:
Anna Li: heads-up — after the kernel-selector change we merged yesterday I see repeated short CPU stalls and very spiky host-side allocation behavior in prod. nsys shows a cluster of host allocations aligning with batch boundaries. attaching quick notes and traces.
Anna Li: captured with nsys (short):
```
nsys profile --sample=none --trace=cuda,nvtx --output=alloc-burst-2056 ./prod-run
// timeline: 00:01:23 - 00:01:28 dominated by many cudaMalloc calls on host, each ~100-300us, back-to-back
// GPU kernels look fine but there's a ~30-90ms window where throughput drops because host thread is blocked
```
Miguel Santos: yikes. did the kernel selector push change batching or kernel choice heuristics? iirc we switched to the new contiguous-block allocator in selector v2.
Anna Li: @Miguel yeah selector-v2 picks larger compute tiles for better cache locality, but I didn't expect it to change host allocation patterns. hypothesis: tile switch causes KV cache misses -> more staging allocations for past-kv merges -> host-side cudaMallocs (we still use non-async path in several codepaths).
Sasha P: can you paste the NVTX slice around the alloc bursts? if KV eviction triggers a big copy+alloc it's probably that. also did you see any cudaFree spikes that line up? sometimes free + realloc churns.
Anna Li: snippet from perfetto/nvtx view shows: 
```
[kv-merge] NVTX: start 00:01:22.900
host: allocate staging buffer 6MB -> cudaMalloc 00:01:23.001 (120us)
kernel: tile_compute_x 00:01:23.150 (5ms)
host: repeat allocate 6MB -> cudaMalloc 00:01:23.260 (180us)
// repeat ~18 times over 4s
```
no matching cudaFree spikes; seems we accumulate short-lived allocations.
Kevin O'Connor: Could be fragmentation in the per-device arena where small repeated allocs don't get reused because sizes vary slightly. Also if we allocate without cudaMallocAsync we hit the global allocator path which serializes.
Miguel Santos: experiments to try:
- re-run with CUDA 11/12 cudaMallocAsync enabled + set CUDAMALLOC_ASYNC_POOL_SIZE to something small on prod replica to test behavior
- enable allocator pool metrics (we have a debug build that reports arena slab reuse rate)
- capture a detailed timeline with nsys+sampled-host to correlate threads
Anna Li: ordering a short A/B: one replica with async pool on, one with current settings. I'll attach perf traces once done. low friction: change env var at container start.
perf-bot: deployment notice -> rolling restart of model-serve-prod-group-3 started by Anna Li at 2056010100
Sasha P: short-term mitigation: we can change kernel-selector to avoid the particular tile-size switch when KV cache pressure is above threshold. That would be quick revert path if async pool doesn't help.
Kevin O'Connor: long-term: we should add a prewarm path for staging buffers: maintain a small slab cache keyed by buffer-size-buckets to avoid host-side cudaMalloc thrash. also consider making the KV-merge allocate from our arena via cudaMallocAsync with an owned stream so frees are deferred and reused.
Anna Li: notes from first A/B run: async-pool replica shows 10x fewer host-side cudaMallocs in the same 30s window. throughput recovered ~5-8% and tail p99 latency reduced by ~18ms. total memory usage slightly higher (expected). i'll push full traces to perf bucket.
Miguel Santos: nice. can you add the exact env diff and the perf urls? i'll make a small playbook entry for enable/disable of async pool and the selector rollback trigger (if p99 > 150ms for 5m).
Anna Li: env diff: 
```
# async pool ON
export CUDAMALLOC_ASYNC=1
export CUDAMALLOC_ASYNC_POOL_SIZE=256M
export REDWOOD_ALLOC_DEBUG=arena_metrics
```
perf traces: https://perf.internal/redwood/2056009999/trace-async.html (async)
https://perf.internal/redwood/2056009999/trace-sync.html (baseline)
Sasha P: will follow up with a small patch to kernel-selector that adds a KV-pressure gate. keep the traces coming, i'll triage slab reuse numbers tomorrow and sketch a slab-bucket plan.
Kevin O'Connor: for the repo task: I'll create a ticket to add a per-buffer-size freelist and a flag to prefer cudaMallocAsync paths when on dedicated infra. also add unit for arena churn metric we can alert on.
Anna Li: thanks all. action items:
- Anna: finish A/B and upload nsys/perfetto captures (in progress)
- Miguel: add rollback playbook & alert thresholds (in PR)
- Sasha: slab-buckets design + small selector gate patch (wip)
- Kevin: ticket for freelist + arena metrics (created)

Anna Li: ping me if you want me to re-run with extra nvprof markers or longer run. thx :thumbsup:
